label: Check contamination and relatedness before analysis
prompt: Check these genotypes for contamination and relatedness before I analyse them.
answerHead:
BioMate

seqvartools — Quality control and relatedness analysis for VCF genotypes, detecting contamination, pedigree discordance, and sample swaps.

Input: ceph1463_genotypes.vcf.gz (VCF, GRCh37/b37, 19,991 sites, 17 samples); ceph1463.ped (pedigree file with declared relationships and sexes)
Key steps:
Parse VCF and pedigree; compute genotype-inferred relatedness (IBS, pi-hat) and sex concordance
Flag heterozygosity outliers, allele-balance deviations, and depth anomalies (FORMAT: GT, DP, RO, AO)
Compare inferred kinship to declared pedigree relationships
Expected output: Relatedness matrix + pedigree check report (inferred vs. declared pi-hat, kinship coefficients); sex concordance table; heterozygosity and depth summaries; flagged samples and sample-pair anomalies (contamination / swap candidates)

Note on data: This workflow does not read your attached VCF and PED files directly — it is parameter-configured. However, seqvartools is designed specifically for pedigree QC and will accept your files when you bind them in the parameter panel. Review the panel and click Confirm & Run to execute.

These are Illumina Platinum Genomes (CEPH 1463, public tutorial dataset from the peddy repository). Depth-based contamination metrics are limited to the 19,991 sites in this subset; for a full genome, a larger variant set and higher coverage are expected to improve signal.
